runs.text: On a 3 × 3 board kept with two indices, which position is the centre cell?
In each dimension, the indices of a board of 3 go from 0 to 2. The middle one is 1, in rows and in columns.

justification.text: Indices start at 0: the centre is the second row and the second column.
It would be the centre if indices started at 1; in PseudoLearn it is the bottom right corner.
It is the cell on the right edge of the middle row.
